panels.title: Big questions
points: How can one angle tell you all the others?
Why are the angles in a Z shape always equal?
Why do the angles in any quadrilateral add to 360°?
Why are the exterior angles of every polygon 360° in total?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Muslim astronomers and builders used exact angle facts to find the qiblah and lay out masjids. Writing a reason for every step is like giving evidence for every claim, which Islam asks of us (al-Baqarah 2:111: 'Bring your proof, if you are truthful').

panels.title: Two lines cross. One angle is 70°. Find the others.
points: Opposite angle = 70°: vertically opposite angles are equal
Next angle = 180° - 70° = 110°: angles on a straight line

panels.title: A triangle has angles 48° and 67°. Find the third.
points: Angles in a triangle add up to 180°

panels.title: A transversal makes 65° with one parallel line. Find the alternate angle and the co-interior angle.
points: Alternate angle = 65°: alternate angles are equal
Co-interior = 180° - 65° = 115°: co-interior angles add up to 180°
